tasks.title: Setup monorepo Nx + Python uv workspaces
tasks.description: Inicializar monorepo Nx con plugin @nxlv/python. Crear workspaces para domain, application, adapters/{api,orchestrator,browser,llm,storage,parsing,sandbox}, banks/banco_general, shared/schemas. Python 3.12+, uv como package manager, Ruff + Pyrefly como linters.
tasks.details: Estructura: ver PRD §Technical Considerations. Comandos: nx generate @nxlv/python:application api, etc. pyproject.toml por package. Workspace root con uv workspace member list. Configurar pre-commit hooks: ruff check, ruff format, pyrefly.
tasks.testStrategy: nx run-many --target=lint --all pasa. uv sync --all-extras sin errores. nx graph muestra deps correctas (domain ← application ← adapters).

tasks.title: Hexagonal scaffolding: domain + application layers
tasks.description: Crear entidades del dominio (Job, Account, Transaction, BankMap, Credential, BreakageEvent) y puertos (ScraperPort, OrchestratorPort, StoragePort, LLMPort, BrowserPort, SandboxPort, ParserPort). Use cases en application/.
tasks.details: Entidades Pydantic v2 inmutables. Puertos como Protocols (typing.Protocol). Use cases: StartScrapeJob, ConfirmOTP, ApplyRemapProposal, ListAccounts, GetJobResult. Schema canónico unificado con discriminator account_type (savings|checking|credit_card). Ver PRD §REQ-008 + DECISIONS.md.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests por entidad (validators, invariants). Use cases probados con mocks de puertos via PydanticAI test models. Pyrefly pasa en domain/ + application/.

tasks.title: FastAPI skeleton: 10 endpoints stub + OpenAPI 3.1
tasks.description: Implementar API REST con 10 endpoints (REQ-001) como stubs que devuelven 501 Not Implemented. Bearer token auth single-org. Idempotency keys. Rate limiting por banco. OpenAPI 3.1 spec auto-generada.
tasks.details: Endpoints: POST /scrape, GET /jobs/{id}, GET /jobs/{id}/result, POST /jobs/{id}/otp-confirmed, POST /jobs/{id}/cancel, POST /maps/{bank}/proposals/{id}/approve, POST /maps/{bank}/proposals/{id}/reject, GET /banks, GET /accounts, POST /webhooks/test. Middleware: idempotency (header Idempotency-Key + Redis/SQLite store), rate-limit slowapi, auth bearer. Pydantic schemas request/response.
tasks.testStrategy: TestClient httpx: cada endpoint responde con schema correcto. OpenAPI spec validable con openapi-spec-validator. Auth bloquea sin bearer.

tasks.title: Storage adapter SQLite + sqlcipher
tasks.description: Implementar StoragePort con SQLite cifrada via sqlcipher. Tablas: credentials, jobs, accounts, transactions, dedup_index, audit_log, webhook_outbox. Migrations con alembic. Master passphrase desde env → Argon2id KDF → AES-GCM (REQ-008).
tasks.details: pysqlcipher3 o sqlite3 con extensión sqlcipher. Argon2id (argon2-cffi) deriva clave de passphrase. AES-GCM encripta values sensibles a nivel campo (creds). Backup del .db es opaco sin passphrase. Tests con DB en tmpfs.
tasks.testStrategy: Backup file abierto sin passphrase falla (verificación binaria). Argon2 params dentro de OWASP recommendations. Round-trip credentials encrypt/decrypt. Migration up/down funciona.

tasks.title: Secret vault: Argon2id + AES-GCM + filter middleware
tasks.description: Vault que recibe master passphrase env → deriva clave Argon2id → cifra/descifra credentials con AES-GCM. Filter middleware redact que garantiza que credenciales nunca lleguen a logs/Langfuse/OTel/HAR (REQ-016, Issue #1).
tasks.details: Vault API: encrypt(plaintext, aad)/decrypt(ciphertext, aad). Filter middleware intercepta logging.LogRecord, OTel span attrs, Langfuse traces, Playwright HAR sanitizer. Canary value SECRET_CANARY_VALUE inyectado en CI; grep en artefactos debe devolver 0 hits.
tasks.testStrategy: Canary CI test: corre scrape mock con SECRET_CANARY_VALUE como password; grep recursivo en logs/HAR/traces falla si aparece. Property-based tests (hypothesis) sobre redact filter.

tasks.title: Temporal local setup + worker scaffolding
tasks.description: docker-compose con Temporal server (dev). Worker Python (temporalio SDK) que registra workflows + activities. Task queue por banco.
tasks.details: docker-compose.dev.yml: temporal + temporal-ui. Worker entry point que registra ScrapeJobWorkflow + 11 activities (placeholders). Logging structurado con trace_id. Configurable via env (TEMPORAL_HOST, TASK_QUEUE).
tasks.testStrategy: Worker conecta a Temporal local. UI muestra workflows registrados. Smoke: dispatch un workflow placeholder, verifica completion.

tasks.title: CI pipeline: ruff + pyrefly + pytest + canary redact
tasks.description: GitHub Actions: lint (ruff check + format), type check (pyrefly), tests (pytest), canary redact test (REQ-016), coverage report. Matrix Python 3.12, 3.13.
tasks.details: Workflow .github/workflows/ci.yml. Jobs: lint, typecheck, test, canary, build-docs. Cache uv. uv pip compile lockfile check. Codecov upload. Required checks para PR merge.
tasks.testStrategy: PR de prueba: todos los checks pasan en branch limpio. Inyectar fallo deliberado (lint warning, canary leak): CI bloquea merge.

tasks.title: USER-TEST checkpoint 1: Foundation review
tasks.description: Validación de usuario al cierre de Phase 1. Verificar: monorepo arranca, FastAPI sirve OpenAPI en /docs, Temporal UI accesible, sqlite cifrada, CI verde, canary test corre.
tasks.details:
Checklist:
- [ ] uv sync && nx build api OK
- [ ] curl localhost:8000/docs renderiza
- [ ] Temporal UI localhost:8233 muestra worker conectado
- [ ] Backup .db inspeccionado: contenido cifrado
- [ ] CI corrió canary y redact funcionó
- [ ] Repo public en GitHub bajo AGPL-3.0
tasks.testStrategy: Demo en vivo. Si falla algún ítem, rollback a checkpoint anterior con bash .taskmaster/scripts/rollback.sh.

tasks.title: Scraper runner Playwright: 9 step types (sin LLM)
tasks.description: REQ-004. Runner que lee map.json y ejecuta steps secuencialmente: navigate, click, fill, wait_for_selector, wait_for_download, select_date_range, assert_text, extract_table, download_file. CERO llamadas LLM.
tasks.details: Playwright async API. Cada step type es una función pura (context, step_def) → Result. sensitive_data injection antes de fill (placeholder substitution). Timeout configurable por step. Screenshot on failure. HAR record en debug.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit por step type. Integration: corre map.json fixture contra HTML estático servido por aiohttp test server. Verifica 0 llamadas a litellm/anthropic/deepseek (mock + assert no_call).

tasks.title: BreakageEvent contract + emit on step failure
tasks.description: Schema Pydantic BreakageEvent: step_id, step_type, expected, actual, screenshot_path, dom_snapshot, error, timestamp. Emit cuando step falla. Consumido por Judge.
tasks.details: BreakageEvent inmutable. Persist en jobs.audit_log. screenshot_path apunta a artefacto en sandbox volume. dom_snapshot truncado a 50KB. Webhook event job.failed include breakage payload.
tasks.testStrategy: Forzar fallo en cada step type. Verifica BreakageEvent capturado con todos los campos. Schema contract test.

tasks.title: HAR record/replay testing infrastructure
tasks.description: REQ-015. Playwright HAR record en debug mode. Replay engine para integration tests sin pegarle al banco real. Fixtures por banco anonimizados.
tasks.details: playwright record_har_path + record_har_content omit. Replay con route handler que sirve responses desde HAR. Fixtures en banks/{bank}/fixtures/har/. Anonymizer script que redacta PII antes de commit.
tasks.testStrategy: Test corre HAR fixture banco_general/login.har, obtiene mismo result que live (golden test). Anonymizer test: input con SSN/cuenta → output redacted.

tasks.title: ScrapeJobWorkflow + 11 activities skeleton
tasks.description: REQ-002. Workflow Temporal principal con activities: LoginActivity, NavigateActivity, DownloadExcelActivity, ParseExcelActivity, ValidateActivity, JudgeActivity, MapperAgentActivity, RemapperAgentActivity, EmitWebhookActivity, OTPSignalAwaitActivity, AuditLogActivity. Signals: otp_confirmed, remap_approved, cancel_job.
tasks.details: Workflow determinístico (no datetime.now, no random). Activities son no-determinísticas. OTPSignalAwaitActivity con timeout 4 min (banco expira a 5). Retry policies por tipo de activity. Heartbeat para activities largas.
tasks.testStrategy: Temporal time-skipping test framework. Replay test: serializar history, re-ejecutar, verifica determinismo. Cada signal probado independientemente.

tasks.title: USER-TEST checkpoint 2: Scraper runner E2E
tasks.description: Validación Phase 2. Demo: ejecutar map.json fixture mock end-to-end via Temporal workflow. Verifica HAR replay + breakage handling.
tasks.details:
Checklist:
- [ ] map.json fixture corre 9 step types
- [ ] Forzar breakage: BreakageEvent capturado, workflow continua a Judge stub
- [ ] HAR replay produce mismos resultados que primera corrida
- [ ] 0 llamadas LLM en hot path (assert_no_call mock)
- [ ] Temporal UI muestra history completa
tasks.testStrategy: Demo en vivo. Métricas observabilidad capturadas para baseline.

tasks.title: Mapper agent: browser-use + Claude vision
tasks.description: REQ-003. Agente que explora login + dashboard + descarga Excel. Construido sobre librería browser-use (en /Users/mike/Documents/maybe finance/browser-use). Usa sensitive_data para que LLM nunca vea creds plaintext. Emite map.json declarativo.
tasks.details: browser-use Agent con custom tools: emit_map_step, mark_download_target. allowed_domains restringe a dominio banco. sensitive_data dict con placeholders <USERNAME>/<PASSWORD>. LLM = Claude Sonnet 4.6 vision via LiteLLM. Output validado contra JSON Schema map.v1.json.
tasks.testStrategy: Smoke contra banco_general fixture (HAR-recorded login flow). Output map.json schema-valid. sensitive_data fuzz test (REQ-019, Issue #3): instrumenta LiteLLM, verifica que plaintext nunca llega al model input.

tasks.title: Excel parser DSL engine + helpers whitelisted
tasks.description: REQ-007. Engine que evalúa parser.json declarativo. Helpers: parse_date, extract_regex, normalize_amount, lookup_table, coalesce, trim, to_upper, to_lower, concat. NO ejecuta Python arbitrario.
tasks.details: DSL evaluator con AST whitelist (rechaza eval/exec/import). openpyxl para leer Excel. Cada helper es función pura registrada. account_type inference por hoja/título. id_strategy: embedded (extract from cell) vs fingerprint (hash row content). Dedup nivel 1: embedded ID dedup en parser.
tasks.testStrategy: Property-based fuzz test: input parser.json malicioso (intenta eval, file io, network) → rechazado. Fixtures Excel anonimizados de Banco General → output schema canónico. Sandbox test: helper exec no escapa al filesystem host.

tasks.title: Banco General: primer mapping run + map.json + parser.json
tasks.description: REQ-012 (Phase 3). Ejecutar Mapper contra Banco General real (creds operador) → produce banks/banco_general/map.json. Escribir parser.json para savings + checking + credit_card. Fixtures HAR + Excel anonimizados commiteados.
tasks.details: Banco piloto: Banco General. Auth Clave Móvil (push 2FA, no SMS). Sesión expira ~5 min. Sin captcha conocido. Cuentas multi-tipo. Detalle en docs/06-banks/banco-general.md.
tasks.testStrategy: Validar map.json schema. Ejecutar Scraper runner contra HAR fixture: completa flow login + descarga Excel para 3 tipos cuenta. Parser.json produce N transacciones esperadas (golden file).

tasks.title: Schema canónico unificado + 3-niveles dedup
tasks.description: Pydantic models cross-package en shared/schemas/. discriminator account_type. Transaction unificado (date, amount, currency, description, merchant, category, balance_after, source_id, fingerprint). Dedup engine 3 niveles (REQ-008): embedded ID → fingerprint hash → fuzzy match transfers cross-account.
tasks.details: shared/schemas/canonical.py. Fingerprint = sha256(date+amount+description_normalized+account_id). Fuzzy matching para transfers: pareo por amount opuesto + ventana ±2 días + cuentas distintas mismo dueño. Persiste en dedup_index.
tasks.testStrategy: Fixtures con duplicados intencionales (mismo embedded ID, mismo fingerprint, transfers cross-account). Engine elimina correctamente. Transfer detection precision/recall ≥ 0.9 sobre fixture.

tasks.title: USER-TEST checkpoint 3: Banco General piloto
tasks.description: Validación Phase 3. Demo end-to-end: POST /scrape → OTP push Clave Móvil → POST /jobs/{id}/otp-confirmed → workflow completa → GET /jobs/{id}/result devuelve N transacciones canónicas dedup.
tasks.details:
Checklist:
- [ ] map.json banco_general commiteado
- [ ] parser.json para 3 tipos cuenta
- [ ] Demo en vivo: scrape real con creds operador
- [ ] Transacciones canónicas (no Excel raw)
- [ ] Dedup nivel 1+2 funciona
- [ ] LLM cost del job ≤ $0.50
tasks.testStrategy: Demo controlada. Capturar métricas: tiempo total, $ LLM, tokens, success rate.

tasks.title: Validator + Judge agents (PydanticAI + DeepSeek)
tasks.description: REQ-005. Validator hace checks heurísticos + LLM cuando ambiguo. Judge analiza BreakageEvent + screenshot y decide ruta (retry / partial_remap / full_remap / abort / human_required) + confidence + risk.
tasks.details: PydanticAI Agent con structured output JudgeDecision { route, confidence: float, risk: enum[low,medium,high], reasoning }. LLM = DeepSeek V3 via LiteLLM (cost near-zero). Validator es heurístico-first; LLM solo si heurístico inconcluso. Judge recibe BreakageEvent + screenshot embedded base64 (vision-capable model).
tasks.testStrategy: Fixture set de BreakageEvents conocidos + screenshots → JudgeDecision esperado (golden). Cost per judge call < $0.001. PydanticAI test models para unit tests sin gastar tokens.

tasks.title: Remapper agent + dry-run validation
tasks.description: REQ-006. Re-explora la zona afectada (usando browser-use) y emite patch al map.json. Dry-run validation antes de full apply (sin enviar creds reales). Auto-apply si Judge dice confidence ≥ 0.85 AND risk == low.
tasks.details: RemapperAgent con browser-use limitado al subset del flow. Output: MapPatch (JSON Patch RFC 6902). Dry-run: aplica patch sobre map.json, ejecuta scraper en sandbox con creds dummy + HTML actual del banco, verifica steps no-fail. Si OK → ApplyMapPatch activity (git commit + tag).
tasks.testStrategy: Simulate UI change: modificar HAR fixture (selector renombrado). Remapper produce patch correcto, dry-run pasa. Test: confidence < 0.85 → no auto-apply, emite job.remap_proposed webhook.

tasks.title: Proposal endpoints + TTL + git apply (HITL flow)
tasks.description: Endpoints POST /maps/{bank}/proposals/{id}/approve|reject. TTL configurable (default 7d, expira a rejected). Aplicación via git commit en banks/{bank}/map.json. Webhook job.remap_proposed + job.human_required.
tasks.details: Tabla map_proposals (id, bank, patch_json, judge_decision, status, created_at, expires_at). Approve → ApplyMapPatch activity. Reject → status=rejected. Cron cleanup expired. Audit log con quien aprobó (operator_id desde bearer token).
tasks.testStrategy: Approve flow: proposal pending → POST approve → git log muestra commit, map.json updated, webhook emitted. Reject flow + TTL expiry tests.

tasks.title: USER-TEST checkpoint 4: Self-healing flow
tasks.description: Validación Phase 4. Demo: simular cambio UI banco → BreakageEvent → Judge decide remap → Remapper produce patch → auto-apply (alta confidence) o HITL (baja confidence) → re-corrida exitosa.
tasks.details:
Checklist:
- [ ] Inyectar HAR modificado (selector cambiado)
- [ ] Workflow detecta breakage, llama Judge
- [ ] Auto-apply path: patch aplicado sin intervención
- [ ] HITL path: webhook recibido, approve via API, patch aplicado
- [ ] Re-scrape post-patch exitoso
tasks.testStrategy: 2 demos (auto y HITL). Métricas: tiempo decisión Judge, tiempo total recovery.

tasks.title: Sandbox Docker per-job + network policies
tasks.description: REQ-009. Container efímero por scrape. Network allowlist (dominio banco + APIs LLM). Caps dropped, seccomp, AppArmor, read-only rootfs (excepto tmpfs + /downloads), no-new-privileges, non-root user, resource limits.
tasks.details: Dockerfile sandbox image (Playwright + Python). docker run --network sandbox-net --cap-drop=ALL --read-only --tmpfs /tmp --user 1000 --pids-limit 200 --memory 2g --cpus 1.5. Network allowlist via iptables/network policy o DNS-based (allowed_domains en browser-use). Container destroyed on workflow complete/fail.
tasks.testStrategy: Smoke endpoints prohibidos: container intenta GET https://example.com → bloqueado. Container intenta escribir / → read-only. Process count > limit → killed. Resource exhaust → kernel OOM, no host impact.

tasks.title: docker-socket-proxy hardening + smoke tests (PROMOVIDO A P0 / Phase 1)
tasks.description: REQ-018 (P0 tras master feedback), Issue #2. Si worker necesita acceso al socket Docker para spawn sandbox containers, usar tecnomancy/docker-socket-proxy con allowlist mínima. Smoke test endpoints prohibidos. PROMOVIDO de Phase 5/P2 a Phase 1/P0 porque Phase 3 piloto correría con socket exposure si esto queda al final.
tasks.details: docker-compose service socket-proxy. Worker conecta vía proxy, no socket directo. ENV CONTAINERS=1, NETWORKS=1, BUILD=0, EXEC=0, etc. Smoke: GET /containers/json (allowed) vs DELETE /networks/host (blocked). Phase asignada: 1 (Foundation).
tasks.testStrategy: Suite de pytest: cada endpoint Docker API verificado allow/deny según whitelist. Compromise simulation: credentials leaked, attacker tries privileged ops via socket → fails.

tasks.title: Webhooks HMAC-SHA256 + retry + DLQ + /time endpoint
tasks.description: REQ-010, REQ-020. 7 eventos webhook. Header X-OpenBanca-Signature: t=<ts>,v1=<hmac>. Retry exponential 6 intentos en 24h. Anti-replay window ±5 min. Endpoint /time para diagnosis clock skew. DLQ si excede retry budget.
tasks.details: Eventos: job.created, job.otp_required, job.progress, job.completed, job.failed, job.remap_proposed, job.human_required. Tabla webhook_outbox (id, event, payload, signature, attempts, next_retry_at, dlq). Worker async procesa outbox. Endpoint GET /time devuelve UTC timestamp ISO + monotonic.
tasks.testStrategy: Cliente test verifica firma HMAC contra payload + secret. Replay attack (mismo timestamp viejo) → rechazado. Forzar 6 fallos → DLQ. /time vs system clock match.

tasks.title: Cost guardrails enforcement
tasks.description: REQ-011. Max $0.50 LLM/job, max 3 remap attempts/24h por banco, max 1 mapping run/24h por banco, max 2 logins fallidos consecutivos → circuit breaker 1h, max tokens per agent per job.
tasks.details: Middleware central LLMCostTracker (intercepta LiteLLM responses, suma usage * pricing). Tabla rate_limits (bank, op, count, window_start). Circuit breaker estado in-memory + persisted. Si exceeded: workflow fails con job.failed reason=budget_exceeded.
tasks.testStrategy: Forzar límites en test (override config a thresholds bajos). Verifica abort + reason correcto + webhook emitted. Concurrent jobs no race.

tasks.title: Observabilidad: Langfuse self-hosted opcional + OTel
tasks.description: REQ-013, REQ-014. Langfuse docker-compose service con profile langfuse (off por default). Trazas LLM (Mapper/Validator/Judge/Remapper). OTel para API + Temporal + Sandbox. trace_id propagado end-to-end.
tasks.details: LiteLLM callback Langfuse (opcional). OpenTelemetry SDK con OTLP exporter (configurable: jaeger, tempo, console). Trace context propagation: HTTP header → Temporal context → sandbox env. Langfuse profile en docker-compose, off por default mantiene principio self-host puro.
tasks.testStrategy: Profile off: stack arranca sin Langfuse. Profile on: trazas LLM visibles en UI. OTel trace muestra job end-to-end (API → Workflow → Activity → Sandbox).

tasks.title: Community maps trust model: linter 12 reglas + cosign keyless
tasks.description: REQ-017, Issue #4. Linter para community-submitted map.json (12 reglas: no eval, allowed step types, sensitive_data placeholders válidos, allowed_domains coincide con banco, etc.). Maps oficiales firmados con cosign keyless GitHub OIDC.
tasks.details: scripts/lint-map.py. Reglas en docs/04-security/community-maps.md. Pipeline GitHub Actions valida PRs community → linter + sign con cosign --keyless --identity-token=$ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN. Verificación en runtime al cargar map: cosign verify-blob.
tasks.testStrategy: Linter test: 12 fixtures rule-violating + happy path. PR community simulado: workflow corre lint, sign, verify. Map sin firma → runtime rechaza.

tasks.title: USER-TEST checkpoint 5: Operations + security
tasks.description: Validación Phase 5. Auditoría: 5 issues de seguridad (Issues #1-#5) cerrados. Sandbox compromiso simulation. Webhook signature verificada por cliente externo. Cost guardrails activos.
tasks.details:
Checklist:
- [ ] Issue #1 (canary redact): green
- [ ] Issue #2 (docker-socket-proxy): smoke pasa
- [ ] Issue #3 (sensitive_data fuzz): plaintext nunca llega LLM
- [ ] Issue #4 (community maps): linter + cosign
- [ ] Issue #5 (clock skew /time): endpoint live
- [ ] Sandbox escape attempt simulado: contenido
- [ ] Cost guardrail forzado: aborta correctamente
tasks.testStrategy: Auditoría manual + scripts automated checks (.taskmaster/scripts/security-audit.py).

tasks.title: v1.0.0 release: E2E smoke 3 betatesters + stress 100 scrapes + docs + tag
tasks.description: Phase 6. E2E smoke con creds reales (3 betatesters distintos, distintos perfiles cuentas). Stress test 100 scrapes secuenciales/concurrentes. Documentación completa. v1.0.0 git tag + release notes en GitHub. AGPL-3.0 confirmada.
tasks.details: Betatesters: 3 perfiles (1 cuenta, 4 cuentas, ex-cliente con TC vencida). Stress 100 scrapes: medir success rate (target ≥ 95% REQ-012 AC), p50/p95 latency, $ total LLM, breakages capturados. Docs: README quickstart, docs/05-operations/deployment.md, docs/06-banks/banco-general.md final. Release notes con highlights + known limitations.
tasks.testStrategy: Métricas finales documentadas. Si success rate < 95%, no release; root-cause y fix antes de tag. Verificar AGPL-3.0 LICENSE + headers en source files.

tasks.title: Wire FastAPI endpoints to use cases (replace 501 stubs)
tasks.description: Gap del review #4: T3 deja endpoints como 501 stubs. Esta task los conecta a los use cases reales de application/ (StartScrapeJob, ConfirmOTP, ApplyRemapProposal, ListAccounts, GetJobResult, CancelJob, ApproveProposal, RejectProposal, TestWebhook, GetTime). Cada endpoint pasa a estado funcional sobre Temporal client + StoragePort.
tasks.details: Endpoints a wire: POST /scrape → StartScrapeJob → Temporal client.start_workflow. GET /jobs/{id} → query workflow + storage. GET /jobs/{id}/result → GetJobResult. POST /jobs/{id}/otp-confirmed → signal otp_confirmed. POST /jobs/{id}/cancel → signal cancel_job. POST /maps/{bank}/proposals/{id}/approve|reject → ApplyMapPatch / RejectProposal. GET /banks → static config. GET /accounts → storage query. POST /webhooks/test → emit test webhook. GET /time → REQ-020 endpoint. Dependency injection via FastAPI Depends().
tasks.testStrategy: Integration tests con Temporal time-skipping: cada endpoint dispara la cadena correcta de workflows/signals. Storage backed por SQLite in-memory para tests. Coverage por endpoint ≥ 90%.

tasks.title: Incremental scrape: cursor `since` storage + API params + buffer logic
tasks.description: Gap del review #4: Story 2 AC (scrape incremental con `since`) no tiene task asignada. Implementar cursor por cuenta (persiste tras cada scrape exitoso), parámetro `since` en POST /scrape, ventana de descarga = `since - 3 días` (buffer) hasta hoy.
tasks.details: Tabla `account_cursors` (account_id, bank, last_scrape_at, last_transaction_date, etag/range). API: POST /scrape acepta `{since: '2026-01-15'}` o `{since: 'last'}`. Workflow lee cursor, calcula ventana (since - 3d, today), pasa al Scraper runner via map.json params. Tras job.completed, actualiza cursor atómicamente. Dedup nivel 1 maneja overlap del buffer.
tasks.testStrategy: Integration: scrape inicial completo → cursor persistido → segundo scrape con `since: last` → solo trae nuevos. Property test: buffer overlap nunca produce duplicados (depende de dedup nivel 1 estable).

tasks.title: docker-compose full stack (production-equivalent)
tasks.description: Gap del review #4: Story 5 AC pide `docker-compose up` que levanta todo. Existe `docker-compose.dev.yml` (solo Temporal), falta el stack completo: api, temporal-server, temporal-worker, sandbox-runner, postgres (para Temporal), docker-socket-proxy. Langfuse opcional via profile.
tasks.details: Archivo `docker-compose.yml` (no .dev). Servicios: api (FastAPI uvicorn), temporal-server, temporal-worker, sandbox-runner, postgres, docker-socket-proxy (T24), langfuse (profile=langfuse, off por default). Volumes: sqlite-data, downloads, maps. Env: OPEN_BANCA_MASTER_PASSPHRASE, API_KEYS via .env. Healthchecks por servicio. Network: backplane interno + sandbox-net aislado.
tasks.testStrategy: Smoke en host fresh: `docker-compose up` + esperar healthchecks + curl localhost:8000/docs OK. Cold start time ≤ 60s. `docker-compose --profile langfuse up` levanta también Langfuse.

tasks.title: CLI `open-banca register-credentials` interactivo
tasks.description: Gap del review #4: Story 5 AC pide CLI para registrar credenciales bancarias interactivamente. Subcomando `open-banca register-credentials --bank banco_general` que solicita usuario/password con prompt seguro (no en historial shell), cifra con vault, persiste en SQLite.
tasks.details: Click o Typer CLI. Subcomandos: `register-credentials`, `list-credentials` (solo metadata), `delete-credentials`, `circuit-breaker reset` (Story 6). Para `register-credentials`: prompt master passphrase si no en env, prompt username (visible), prompt password (getpass), pregunta confirmación, cifra con Vault, inserta en SQLite. Output: `credential_ref` para usar en POST /scrape. Entry point en pyproject.toml: `open-banca = adapters.cli.main:app`.
tasks.testStrategy: CLI tests con Click testing.CliRunner. Mock stdin para password. Verificar que password NO aparece en logs ni en proceso ps. Round-trip: register → list (solo ref + bank) → use en scrape → success.

tasks.title: USER-TEST checkpoint 6: v1.0.0 release validation
tasks.description: Gap del review #4: PRD §Validation Checkpoints define 6 checkpoints pero tasks.json solo tiene 5 (8, 13, 18, 22, 29). Esta task es el checkpoint 6 (release validation), separado de T30 (que ejecuta la release).
tasks.details:
Checklist (PRD §Checkpoint 6):
- [ ] 3 betatesters externos completan setup en ≤ 30 min (Goal 4)
- [ ] Goal 1 (success rate ≥ 95%): medido sobre 100 scrapes reales
- [ ] Goal 2 (self-healing ≥ 70%): medido sobre breakages inducidos
- [ ] Goal 3 (≤ $0.10/scrape estado estable): medido sobre últimas 50 corridas
- [ ] Goal 4 (setup ≤ 30 min): cronómetro de 3 betatesters
- [ ] Goal 5 (0 fugas credenciales): canary CI green últimos 30 días
- [ ] Release notes + docs públicas
- [ ] AGPL-3.0 LICENSE + headers verificados
- [ ] v1.0.0 tag pusheado
tasks.testStrategy: Auditoría final + sign-off del operator. Si algún Goal < target, no release; root-cause y fix antes de tag.
